answer_1.quote: We evaluate the quality of generated text from two such methods, kNN-LM and TRIME, against the output of baseline LMs ... open-ended text completions generated using different decoding algorithms on both the WikiText-103 and PG-19 datasets.

answer_2.quote: We measure quality via the following automatic metrics: MAUVE, RankGen, GPT-3 perplexity, Entity-F1, Seq-Rep-1.

answer_4.quote: We hired three English teachers/editors ... The evaluators' task was to decide which continuation is better, indicate whether it was hard to choose ... and justify their choice in 3 to 4 sentences. The evaluation focused on whether the generated text is grammatical, fluent, consistent, and logical.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were given a prefix and two continuations (one from baseline LM, one from retrieval‑augmented LM) and asked to pick the better one, state if the choice was difficult, and provide a short justification.
